notable_results: Yearly-updated flagship 1/12 pan car. Alexander Hagberg won the IFMAR 1/12 Modified World Championship on the X12; the car is a perennial podium contender at IFMAR Worlds, ETS and US nationals (X12'24/'25/'26 iterations).
notes: Annual model designations (X12'15 through X12'26). X12'25 introduced an all-new one-piece chassis. Manuals/setup sheets archived on teamxray.com and petitrc.com.

notable_results: Dominant modern 1/12 platform. Kemp Anderson was Top Qualifier and Max Machler won 1:12 Spec at the 2023 IFMAR Worlds on Awesomatix; Kemp Anderson won 1:12 Modified at the 2024 MonTech New York Grand Prix on an A12X.
notes: Variants include base A12, A12X and A12WC (the A12WC is the refined IFMAR Spec World Champion edition).

notable_results: Kemp Anderson won the AbsoluteHobbyz 1:12 Modified class at the 2024 MonTech New York Grand Prix on the A12X, with Max Machler (also Awesomatix) on the podium.
notes: Modified-focused evolution of the A12 line, sold alongside the A12WC Spec variant.

notable_results: Refined World Championship edition; described by Red RC as the IFMAR 1:12 Spec World Champion car (Max Machler took the 2023 IFMAR Worlds 1:12 Spec title on Awesomatix).
notes: WC = World Champion spec; released as a kit alongside the A12X in 2024.

notable_results: The Roche P12-2017 spec TQ'd the Halloween Classic and podiumed at IIC in the 2017/18 season; the P12 platform won the 2016 IFMAR 1/12 World Championship. Hayato Ishioka and Kazuki Yamashita raced Roche at the 2023 IFMAR Worlds.
notes: Iterations: Rapide P12 (2015), P12-2017 (USA Spec), P12 V2. Setup sheets archived on petitrc.com.

notable_results: Current Roche 1/12 flagship; Roche remained a represented brand at the 2023 IFMAR 1/12 Worlds. Evo2 features an Ultra-Low-CG aluminium tub chassis and a redesigned centre-pivot roll-centre system.
notes: Latest evolution of the P12 line (2021).

notable_results: CRC (Calandra Racing Concepts) is a represented 1/12 manufacturer at IFMAR Worlds. Frank Calandra raced CRC in 1:12 Spec at the 2023 IFMAR Worlds; Hayato Ishioka finished 8th in Modified on a CRC at the 2020 Worlds.
notes: CRC's 1/12 lineage includes the Gen-X / Carpet Knife families; exact current model designation not confirmed in sourced coverage, listed by brand presence.

notable_results: British Championship-winning GT12/1-12 pan car lineage. Michal Orlowski won the open-class World Champion title on Schumacher per the 2023 IFMAR Worlds chassis-focus coverage.
notes: Variants: Atom 2 (carbon) and Atom 2 S2 (fibreglass), both on a steel-alloy low-CG chassis. Strong in UK GT12 spec racing.

notable_results: European 1/12 competition pan car with adjustable ride height (calibrated shims), wide wheelbase range and a big-bore centre shock. Marketed for high-bite competition use.
notes: Capricorn's first 1/12 pan car platform.

notable_results: USA-spec evolution with a stiffer aluminium chassis and aluminium rear lower pod plate over the standard carbon items, tuned for high-bite US track conditions.
notes: USA Version of the Capricorn 1/12 platform.

notable_results: Premier 1/10 F1 chassis; the X1 issued repeated wins at ETS F1 races in Europe and is a leading EFRA/national F1 platform. Annual editions X1'21 through X1'25.
notes: Graphite rear-wing mount with high/low positions to meet the EFRA wing-height rule. 2024 manual: teamxray.com/downloads/90/x1_2024_manual_low.pdf.

notable_results: Current Roche 1/10 F1 competition kit (aluminium chassis, USA-spec variant available); a frequent benchmark against the Xray X1 in F1 class racing.
notes: Part numbers 152016 (standard) and 152020 (USA Spec aluminium chassis).

notable_results: Evolution of the F110 platform refined on IDFM, ETS, TiTC and CETC racing experience; an established EFRA-legal F1 competition chassis.
notes: Part SER410067. Predecessors include the F110 SF2 (SER410061), with setup sheets archived on petitrc.com.

notable_results: Earlier-generation F110 EP F1 platform, still raced and documented in European F1 series; setup data archived on petitrc.com.
notes: Part SER410061; recent-but-still-raced predecessor to the SF4.

notable_results: Long-running value F1 competition platform; widely used for national and club F1 racing. Reviewed and raced competitively as recently as 2024.
notes: Kit TAM58652. The F104 family (and F104 v2) is the base for many aftermarket conversions (Exotek F1R2). The F105 is a related Tamiya F1 designation.

notable_results: Tamiya Racing Factory high-end F1 kit based on the F104 Ver.II, developed with TRF team data; the TRF101W wide-tread variant targets high-speed foam-tyre circuits.
notes: Kit 42252 (TRF101), 42279 (TRF101W wide-tread). Top-tier Tamiya F1 platform; succeeded by the TRF102.

notable_results: Tamiya's top-end F1 kit succeeding the F104 v2 / TRF101 line in the TRF competition range.
notes: Kit 42289. Successor to the TRF101 in Tamiya's racing F1 lineup.

notable_results: Purpose-built F1 chassis (not a converted 1/12) with a patent-pending floating rear-pod suspension for rubber-tyre F1 traction; a leading modern aftermarket/standalone F1 platform with a dedicated carpet (Carpet Works) variant.
notes: Lineage: F1 Ultra (R4) → F1 Ultra R5 → R5CW Carpet Works. 72mm narrow chassis. Kits EXOF1R5 / EXOF1R5CW. Exotek also makes the F1R2 conversion for the Tamiya F103/F104.

notable_results: Earlier ground-up Exotek F1 Ultra platform (with a Carpet Works conversion), recent-but-still-raced predecessor to the R5.
notes: Kits EXOF1R4 / EXOF1R4CW (Carpet Works).

notable_results: Calandra Racing Concepts F1 platform; the predecessor WTF1-FC16 was IIC, Snowbirds and US Indoor Champion. The WTF1 DS (2020) added revised geometry and front-end parts.
notes: Kit CLN1502. Predecessor: WTF1-FC16 (CLN1501).

notable_results: CRC F1 chassis described by the retailer as IIC, Snowbirds and US Indoor Champion; a proven US carpet/indoor F1 platform.
notes: Kit CLN1501; recent-but-still-raced predecessor to the WTF1 DS.

notable_results: Yokomo's 1/10 F1 competition chassis designed by Naoto Kitagawa with championship intent; a Japanese-brand F1 platform present in competitive F1 racing.
notes: Kit YOKYRF-001W.
